questions.question: What is the main purpose of an informational text?

options.A: To give facts about a topic

questions.explanation: Informational texts present facts and explanations about a topic.

questions.question: Which of the following is an example of informational text?
Headings in an informational text help the reader to...
questions.explanation: Headings organize information so readers can locate sections easily.

questions.question: Which feature is commonly found in informational text?
questions.explanation: Captions, diagrams, and labels accompany factual information.

questions.question: An island is...

options.A: a piece of land surrounded by water

questions.explanation: An island is land that is completely surrounded by water.

questions.question: A small group of islands is called an...
questions.explanation: An archipelago is a chain or cluster of islands.

questions.question: The land along the edge of the sea on an island is called the...
questions.explanation: The coast is the area where the land meets the sea.

questions.question: Indonesia is the largest archipelago in the world with about... islands.
The sign 'No smoking' means you...
A sign that shows 'Stop' means drivers...
Choose the correct sentence: At the library, you ____ keep silent.
questions.explanation: Keeping silent in a library is required.

questions.question: 'You ____ park here' (parking is forbidden).
Which sentence shows obligation?
Which is a physical adjective?
questions.explanation: Physical adjectives describe appearance: tall, short, slim, etc.

questions.question: Which is a personality adjective?
questions.explanation: Personality adjectives describe character: kind, brave, honest.

questions.question: My grandfather has gray ____ and a wrinkled face.
questions.explanation: Hair fits the physical description sentence.

questions.question: Aisha helps everyone. She is very ____.
questions.explanation: Helpful is a personality adjective fitting the description.

questions.question: The ordinal number for 1 is...
The 3rd day of the week (Sunday as 1st) is...
Independence Day of Indonesia is on the ____ of August.
Which is the correct ordinal: 21?
The book is ____ the table.
questions.explanation: On = on top of a surface.

questions.question: The cat is ____ the box (inside).
The library is ____ the school and the post office.
questions.explanation: Between is used for two distinct points/places.

questions.question: The lamp hangs ____ the dining table.
If it is raining, the weather is...
The sun shines brightly. The weather is...
Which weather word fits: 'Strong winds blow and clouds gather.'?
When water vapor freezes and falls down, it is...
questions.explanation: Snow forms when water vapor freezes into crystals.

questions.question: The past form of 'walk' is...
Past form of 'play' is...
Past form of 'study' is...
She ____ (clean) her room yesterday.
questions.explanation: Past simple of regular verb: cleaned.

questions.question: Past form of 'go' is...
Past form of 'eat' is...
Past form of 'write' is...
questions.explanation: Write → wrote (V2). Past participle is written.

questions.question: Past form of 'see' is...
Past form of 'teach' is...
Comparative of 'tall' is...
Superlative of 'big' is...
The comparative of 'beautiful' is...
Superlative of 'good' is...
Mount Everest is ____ mountain in the world.
She ____ to school every day.
We ____ English on Mondays.
questions.explanation: Plural subject 'we' uses base form: study.

questions.question: He ____ TV in the evening.
____ they play football on Saturdays?
I ____ already done my homework.
questions.explanation: Present perfect: have/has + V3. 'I have done.'

questions.question: She ____ visited Bali three times.
Choose the correct sentence:
questions.explanation: Present perfect with 'since' shows action continuing to now.

questions.question: Which time expression fits present perfect?
Yesterday, I ____ a movie with my friends.
questions.explanation: Past simple of regular verb watch → watched.

questions.question: ____ you finish your homework last night?
He ____ to the market two days ago.
She didn't ____ to the party.
I ____ reading a book at 7 p.m. yesterday.
questions.explanation: Past continuous: was/were + V-ing. I was reading.

questions.question: They ____ playing chess when I came home.
While she ____ (cook), the phone rang.
questions.explanation: Past continuous shows ongoing action: was cooking.

questions.question: I ____ visit my grandma tomorrow.
She ____ go to the dentist next Monday.
questions.explanation: Be going to + V1 expresses planned future.

questions.question: Look at the dark clouds! It ____ rain soon.
questions.explanation: 'Be going to' is used for predictions based on evidence.

questions.question: Which is countable?
questions.explanation: Apples can be counted (one apple, two apples).

questions.question: Which is uncountable?
questions.explanation: Milk is uncountable (we say 'a glass of milk').

questions.question: There ____ much sugar left.
How ____ apples do you have?
I'd like a ____ of bread, please.
questions.explanation: A loaf of bread is the correct unit.

questions.question: ____ is at the door.
I don't have ____ to wear.
Is there ____ in the room?
It ____ rain tonight.
She ____ be at the library; I am not sure.
Choose the correct sentence:

options.A: We might go to the beach tomorrow.
options.B: We might to go to the beach.
options.C: We mighting go to the beach.
options.D: We mights go to the beach.

questions.question: Which is a hobby?
questions.explanation: A hobby is a leisure activity such as collecting stamps.

questions.question: What is a person who paints as a hobby called?
I love reading. What is my hobby?
questions.explanation: Reading = enjoying books in your free time.

questions.question: Which item is fashion-related?
What do you wear on your feet?
Traditional Indonesian fabric known worldwide is...
A 'glossary' in an informational book is...

options.A: a list of difficult words and their meanings

questions.explanation: Glossary explains key terms used in the text.

questions.question: The largest island in Indonesia by area is...
questions.explanation: Borneo (Kalimantan) is the largest island in Indonesia (and 3rd in the world).

questions.question: 'Beware of dogs' suggests we should be...
A person who tells the truth is...
December is the ____ month of the year.
The hospital is ____ from my house (a long distance).
When clouds are very thick and the sky looks dark, the day is...
Past form of 'stop' is...
questions.explanation: CVC ending → double consonant + ed: stopped.

questions.question: Past form of 'buy' is...
My bag is ____ than yours.
Aisha and Bilal ____ chess every Sunday.
Have you ever ____ to Bali?
I ____ tired yesterday.
While my mother ____ dinner, I was doing my homework.
questions.explanation: Two parallel ongoing actions in past use past continuous.

questions.question: Promise: 'I ____ help you tomorrow.'
There are only a ____ books on the shelf.
____ is impossible for Allah.
questions.explanation: Nothing = no thing; emphasizes total impossibility.

questions.question: Choose: 'You ____ enter the principal's office now (formal permission).'
Which sentence describes a hobby correctly?
Which is NOT an accessory?
questions.explanation: T-shirt is clothing; the others are accessories.

questions.question: What do we wear in cold weather?
questions.explanation: Jackets keep us warm in cold weather.

questions.question: Sinta enjoys writing stories in her free time. Her hobby is...
questions.explanation: Writing stories = her hobby is writing.

questions.question: The 'index' of a book is found at the...
questions.explanation: Index appears at the back of the book listing topics with page numbers.

questions.question: A small island near a bigger one is sometimes called...
Of all my friends, Ali is ____.
We ____ a great holiday last year.
He ____ just arrived.
Tomorrow we ____ have a math test.
Someone who never gives up is...
When water vapor in the air falls in tiny drops, it is...
questions.explanation: Drizzle = light rain in tiny drops.

questions.question: The dog is sleeping ____ the table (lower side).
'Keep off the grass' means we...
After 'first' comes...
Past form of 'open' is...
Aldrin ____ an astronaut. He often goes to outer space.
My parents ____ in the living room now.
Sylvia usually ____ fried rice in the kitchen.
They ____ to play badminton on Sunday.
Mr. Ari: 'Why ____ you always come late?' Anita: 'I have to sell leaves first.'
questions.explanation: Question with 'you' in simple present uses auxiliary 'do'.

questions.question: Maulana and Arman often ____ football in this field every Saturday.
questions.explanation: Plural subject + frequency adverb → simple present base verb.

questions.question: Egy ____ to play for Barcelona Junior. He wants to play for Lechia Gdansk only.
questions.explanation: Negative simple present, third-person singular uses 'doesn't' + base verb.

questions.question: Syahla ____ feeds her cat every night. She never forgets to do it.
They ____ see the real crocodile. They know it only by watching National Geographic.
questions.explanation: Only know it via TV → they never see the real one.

questions.question: Look! The birds ____ happily.
questions.explanation: Signal word 'Look!' + plural subject → present continuous 'are singing'.

questions.question: Ningsih: 'Where is your mother?' Naruto: 'She ____ in her room now. She feels tired.'
questions.explanation: Action happening now → present continuous 'is sleeping'.

questions.question: Aulia ____ English in the classroom now. She is playing in the school yard now.
questions.explanation: She is playing, so she is NOT studying → 'isn't studying'.

questions.question: Iin: 'Are you playing Indonesia Pintar?' Aan: '____ I am playing UNO.'
questions.explanation: He's playing UNO, not Indonesia Pintar → 'No, I am not.'

questions.question: Mother: 'What ____ honey?' Sisi: 'I am reading a novel, mum.'
questions.explanation: Direct question with 'you' in present continuous.

questions.question: Indah: 'What are you eating, Jessica?' Jessica: '____ Do you want?' Indah: 'No, thanks.'
questions.explanation: Reply must answer 'what are you EATING' → 'I am eating pizza'.

questions.question: Amar: 'Where are our brothers?' Akram: 'Maybe, ____ a nap.'
Syahla: 'Where did your sister go yesterday?' Harits: 'She ____ to Ragunan Zoo.'
Suarez: 'What ____ your previous team?' Ronaldo: 'It was Real Madrid.'
Last night, we ____ at home. My parents went to the wedding.
Ibnu ____ go to the party last night. He was busy with his homework.
questions.explanation: Negative past simple: didn't + base verb.

questions.question: Harun: '____ you watch Transformer 4?' Ismail: 'Yes, I watched it with Rinto.'
Hasan: '____ you the master chef of this hotel?' Rizal: 'Yes, I was. But I resigned last month.'
Abi: 'What did you ____ this morning?' Ummi: 'I cooked fried cassava, dad.'
She ____ an outing program with her classmates last night.
I ____ English when my father called me yesterday.
questions.explanation: Past continuous (was/were + -ing) for ongoing action interrupted by a past event.

questions.question: Some cows ____ grazing on the yard when a thunder hit them.
Dora ____ Thomas and Friends when I knocked the door.
questions.explanation: Ongoing past action (was watching) interrupted by a past event (knocked).

questions.question: While Adam was taking a bath, Raditya ____ the door.
questions.explanation: Ongoing action (was taking a bath) interrupted by a quick action → past simple 'knocked'.

questions.question: Duta was driving his car when suddenly a cow ____ the street.
questions.explanation: Quick interruption to ongoing action takes past simple 'crossed'.

questions.question: Agus: 'What ____ you do when all policemen were searching the ring?' Amri: 'I looked for a good machine to help.'
questions.explanation: Question uses 'did' because Amri's reply 'looked' is past simple.

questions.question: Desy: '____ you cut the tree when I was making the juice?' Ratna: 'No, I didn't do anything.'
Aladin: 'What ____ when a sweeper took your bag?' Dora: 'I was cleaning the floor.'
questions.explanation: Past continuous question matching Dora's reply 'I was cleaning'.

questions.question: Firman: 'What ____ Firman listening to when Duta called him?' Ahmad: 'He ____ listening to GERONIMO FM.'
questions.explanation: Singular subject 'Firman / He' uses 'was' in both clauses.

questions.question: They ____ at a rent house for more than three years.
questions.explanation: Plural subject + 'for X years' → present perfect 'have lived'.

questions.question: Raka: 'How many times have you read Harry Potter?' Indah: 'I ____ it more than five times.'
questions.explanation: Answer to 'have you read' uses present perfect 'have read'.

questions.question: Fujiko ____ Doraemon since 1969.
I ____ many letters from my fans so far.
Conan Edogawa has revealed many criminal cases since ____.
questions.explanation: After 'since' we use a starting point in the past, e.g. 'ten years ago'.

questions.question: He has led Indonesia ____ eight years.
Ahmad Jauhari and Taufik Ismail have stayed in Cibubur ____ 2012.
SpongeBob: '____ you learned how to drive this car, Patrick?' Patrick: 'Not yet, SpongeBob.'
Sue: 'How ____ have the thunderstorms attacked this city?' Sam: 'For almost three hours.'
questions.explanation: 'How long' asks about duration; answer is 'for...'.

questions.question: I ____ to Surabaya by train next week.
Nadia and her sister ____ play tennis tomorrow. They will play badminton.
Hilman ____ do his homework after having breakfast tonight.
questions.explanation: Planned future action → 'is going to' + base verb.

questions.question: Total, Petronas, and Shell will ____ many gasoline stations in Jakarta.
Jowzie and Luthfi ____ have dinner with his family tonight.
questions.explanation: Plural subject + planned future → 'are going to'.

questions.question: Jihan: '____ you come to my party?' Amir: 'Sorry, I won't. I have to sleep early.'
questions.explanation: Reply 'I won't' signals future question → 'Will you...?'

questions.question: Reyhan: 'What ____ to learn now?' Maman: 'I am going to learn chemistry and physics.'
questions.explanation: Reply 'I am going to learn' signals 'going to' question.

questions.question: Ahmad and Husain ____ Indonesian language tomorrow morning.
